brief:
Three years of conflict have left Gaza's urban landscape severely altered, with archive and recent photographs documenting the transformation of the territory's streets, landmarks, and public spaces, Al Jazeera English reported. The visual comparison reveals the extent of physical destruction across the densely populated enclave.

The photographic documentation captures how recognizable locations and infrastructure have been reshaped by the prolonged fighting, illustrating the war's impact on Gaza's built environment and civilian areas.
dek: Archive and recent photos show how three years of war left Gaza's streets, landmarks and public spaces unrecognisable.
title: War transforms Gaza's streets and landmarks beyond recognition
